research_question: Does the apparent low-dimensional pricing advantage depend on how strongly the pricing metric discounts high-variance asset directions?
weight_definition: W_gamma is proportional to (E[RR'] plus ridge I)^(-gamma), normalized so trace(W_gamma E[RR'])/N equals one.
loading_cases: strict factor self-pricing loadings fixed from validation
geometry-specific joint HJ loadings that append traded factors to test assets
diagnostics: asset composition of leading error directions
interpretation_rule: A model is metric-robust only if it weakly dominates the benchmark in self-priced distance, raw moments and alpha across every gamma and both asset families. Ranking reversals across gamma constitute metric-dependent compressibility.
boundary: No training, model selection or sealed-period access. V014 maps the loss geometry and cannot promote a teacher.
